name: Milfheim: The Twisted
source:
Behind quiet walls, beneath gentle smiles…
Everyone is hiding something.

For unknown reasons, Damian (MC) was placed in an orphanage. After spending his teenage years in foster care, he becomes a college student and returns to his hometown, [i]Milfheim[/i], for the first vacation of his university life.

He takes up lodging in a house owned by Helen (Heroine), planning to spend the break meeting friends and new people. But the more time Damian spends under the same roof with Helen, the more he begins to notice another face hidden behind her warm smile.

Milfheim, his hometown, is a beautiful city—not too big, not too small. Yet Damian starts to uncover dark corners he never noticed as a child, plunging him into confusion. He soon realizes that many of the people who shaped his early years are tangled together in a complex web…

Why does Helen grow uneasy whenever the past is brought up?
What truths has his foster mother never spoken?
And the women around Damian—what are your real feelings?

Desire, love, maternal instincts, friendship, envy, jealousy, anger, sorrow…
A storm of emotions crashes into Damian, just as he steps into adulthood, pulling him deep into Milfheim’s hidden, forbidden secrets.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/Bittersweet3D/posts/milfheim-twisted-139098088]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
在寂静的院墙背后，在温柔的微笑之下……
每个人都隐藏着秘密。

由于不明原因，达米安（男主角）自幼被送进了孤儿院。在寄养家庭度过少年时代后，考上大学的他在大学生活的第一个假期回到了故乡——[i]米尔夫海姆[/i]。

他借宿在海伦（女主角）名下的一栋房子里，原本打算趁着假期与老友叙旧、结识新面孔。然而，达米安与海伦在同一屋檐下相处得越久，就越发察觉到她温暖笑容背后隐藏的另一副面孔。

他的故乡米尔夫海姆是一座大小适中的美丽城市，可达米安却开始在城中发掘出儿时从未留意过的阴暗角落，令他陷入深深的迷惘。很快他便意识到，当年塑造他童年岁月的许多大人，竟彼此纠缠在一张错综复杂的罗网之中……

为何每当提及过去，海伦便会神色不安？
养母从未说出口的真相究竟是什么？
还有围绕在达米安身边的女人们——你们内心的真实想法又是什么？

欲望、爱意、母性本能、友情、艳羡、嫉妒、愤怒、悲伤……
就在达米安迈入成年的门槛之际，一场情感风暴向他猛烈袭来，将他深深拽入米尔夫海姆不为人知的禁忌秘密之中。
